item.title: Foreign Ministry's Practical Cooperation Team Launched to Implement Follow-up Measures from Korea-India Summit (한-인도 정상회담 후속조치 이행 맡을 외교부 실질협력팀 출범)
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs launched the "Korea-India Practical Cooperation Team" (TF) on the 27th to oversee follow-up measures from the summit between President Lee Jae-myung and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. (외교부가 이재명 대통령과 나렌드라 모디 인도 총리의 정상회담 후속 조처를 맡을 ‘한-인도 실질협력팀’(TF)을 27일 출범시켰다.)

Through the establishment of this practical cooperation team, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that it will systematically and swiftly implement agreed-upon outcomes from the Korea-India summit, including cooperation in economy, culture, people-to-people exchanges, and collaboration with local governments. President Lee paid a state visit to India from the 19th to the 21st, and after holding a summit with Prime Minister Modi, both sides agreed to elevate bilateral relations to an entirely new level. (외교부는 이번 실질협력팀 신설을 통해 한-인도 정상회담에서 경제, 문화, 인적교류, 지방정부와의 협력 등 합의된 성과 전반을 체계적이고 속도감 있게 이행하겠다고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 지난 19~21일 인도를 국빈방문해 모디 총리와 정상회담을 한 뒤 양국 관계를 완전히 다른 차원으로 발전시키기로 합의했다.)

The practical cooperation team will be led by the Deputy Minister for Asia-Pacific Affairs at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and will comprise eight members, including working-level staff from the Asia-Pacific Bureau, the Bilateral Economic Diplomacy Bureau, and the International Law Bureau. On the same day, the Ministry held a video conference with the Embassy in India, the Consulate General in Chennai, the Consulate General in Mumbai, related agencies in India, and honorary consuls in India to discuss specific operational plans for the practical cooperation team, implementation plans for summit outcome projects, and ways to cooperate with Indian local governments to support Korean companies' entry into the market. (실질협력팀은 외교부 아시아태평양 심의관이 팀장을 맡고 아시아태평양국, 양자경제외교국, 국제법률국 실무 직원 등 총 8명으로 출범한다. 외교부는 이날 주인도대사관, 주첸나이 총영사관, 주뭄바이 총영사관, 인도 주재 유관 기관 및 인도 내 명예영사 등과 화상회의를 개최해 실질협력팀의 구체적 활동 방안과 정상회담 성과사업 이행 방안, 우리 기업 진출 지원을 위한 인도 지방정부와의 협력 방안 등에 대해 논의했다.)

In a joint press statement following the Korea-India summit held at Hyderabad House in New Delhi on the 20th (local time), President Lee stated, "We have agreed to strengthen cooperation not only in trade and investment but also in strategic sectors such as critical minerals, nuclear power, and clean energy." Prime Minister Modi also said, "We will establish an industrial cooperation committee to strengthen cooperation on core technologies and supply chains between the two countries and initiate an economic security dialogue." This led to discussions on setting up a "Korea Desk" within the Indian Prime Minister's Office and an "India Economic Cooperation Task Force" in our (Korean) Office of the President, as well as the establishment of a ministerial-level "Industrial Cooperation Committee" as an economic cooperation platform. (이 대통령은 지난 20일(현지시각) 뉴델리 하이데라바드 하우스에서 열린 한-인도 정상회담 뒤 공동언론발표에서 “무역과 투자뿐 아니라 핵심 광물, 원전, 청정에너지 등 전략 분야의 협력을 강화하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 모디 총리도 “산업협력위원회를 신설해 양국 핵심 기술과 공급망 관련 협력을 강화하고, 경제안보 대화를 시작할 것”이라고 말했다. 이를 계기로 인도 총리실 내 ‘한국 전담 데스크’와 우리 청와대 내 ‘인도 경제협력 전담반’ 설치가 논의됐으며, 장관급 경제협력 플랫폼인 ‘산업협력위원회’도 신설하기로 했다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party finalizes Hong Deok-hee, lawyer in 'valley murder' case, as candidate for Seoul's Guro District Office (국힘, ‘계곡살인 변호’ 홍덕희 서울 구로구청장 후보로 최종 결정)
item.description:
The People Power Party's Seoul Metropolitan Party Nomination Management Committee has finalized the decision to nominate lawyer Hong Deok-hee as the candidate for the Guro District Office. Earlier, the People Power Party had announced Hong's single nomination, but upon learning that she had defended Lee Eun-hae, who was sentenced to life imprisonment for the so-called 'valley murder case,' the party decided to reconsider the nomination from scratch. (국민의힘 서울시당 공천관리위원가 홍덕희 변호사를 구로구청장 후보로 공천하기로 최종 결정했다. 앞서, 국민의힘은 홍 변호사의 단수 공천을 발표했다가 이른바 ‘계곡 살인사건'으로 무기징역을 선고받은 이은해를 변호한 이력이 알려지자 공천 여부를 원점 재검토하기로 했다.)

The People Power Party's Seoul Metropolitan Party announced through a press release on Tuesday: "At yesterday's Seoul Metropolitan Party Nomination Management Committee meeting, we re-discussed Hong Deok-hee's candidacy for the Guro District Office and decided to maintain the original nomination." (국민의힘 서울시당은 이날 언론 공지를 통해 “어제 서울시당 공천관리위원회 회의에서 홍덕희 구로구청장 후보에 대해 재논의해 공천 원안 유지 결정을 했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Seoul Metropolitan Party explained: "The controversial Lee Eun-hae case was handled as pro bono legal representation, and the candidate provided clarification that this was based on a legal professional's sense of responsibility, ensuring that all citizens of the Republic of Korea are guaranteed the minimum basic right to defense, as constitutionally protected, when standing trial under the law." It added: "Considering the candidate's will to transform the long-stagnant Guro district into a place residents can tangibly feel, as well as the support and requests from Guro party members, we made our judgment after comprehensively reviewing the candidate's overall career and capabilities. We also decided to accept the strong requests from the Guro Gap and Eul district party chapters." (서울시당은 “논란이 된 이은해 사건은 무료 변론했고, 이는 대한민국 모든 국민은 법의 심판대에 설 때 헌법에 보장된 최소한의 기본적 변호권을 보장받아야 한다는 법조인의 책임감에 따른 것이었다는 후보자 본인의 소명이 있었다”고 설명했다. 또 “오랫동안 침체한 구로를 주민이 체감할 만큼 변화시키겠다는 후보자의 의지와 구로 당원들의 성원과 요청이 있었다”며 “후보자의 전체 경력과 역량을 종합 고려해 판단했고, 구로지역 갑·을 당협의 강력한 요청을 수용하기로 했다”고 덧붙였다.)

Hong's nomination will be finalized through a vote by the party's Supreme Council, in accordance with party constitution and rules. (홍 후보의 공천안은 당헌·당규에 따라 당 최고위원회의 의결로 확정된다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cho Seung-rae: "Review of Kim Yong's Candidacy in Other Regions Also Difficult" (조승래 “김용, 다른 지역에 대한 공천 검토도 어렵다”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 27th that it would not nominate former Deputy Director of the Democratic Research Institute, Kim Yong, for the June 3 by-elections for the National Assembly. (더불어민주당이 6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거에서 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장을 공천하지 않는다고 27일 밝혔다.)

After announcing the results of strategic nominations for three regions, including Gap in Hanam, Gyeonggi Province, Pyeongtaek-eul, and Ansan-gap, Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae responded to reporters' questions about whether former Deputy Director Kim, who was not nominated in the Gyeonggi region, could be nominated in another area. He stated, "While there were opinions from many inside and outside the party that former Deputy Director Kim should be given an opportunity due to his contributions to the party and the president, the party comprehensively assessed the impact on the local elections and the parliamentary by-elections and concluded that it was appropriate not to nominate him." He added, "You can understand that a review of his candidacy in other regions is also difficult." <<> On this day, the Democratic Party finalized its by-election nominations for five regions in Gyeonggi Province by strategically nominating former Gangwon Province Governor Lee Gwang-jae for Gap in Hanam, former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam for Pyeongtaek-eul, and former lawmaker Kim Nam-guk for Ansan-gap. <<> Former Deputy Director Kim, a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung, was sentenced to five years in prison in an appeals trial for receiving illegal political funds and bribes from private developers in the Daejang-dong scandal. He is currently out on bail and awaiting the Supreme Court's ruling. Earlier that day, Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Geon-tae held a press conference supporting Kim's candidacy, stating, "Former Deputy Director Kim is not just a politician, but a symbolic figure showing how the abuse of prosecutorial power can destroy an individual's life." Many pro-Lee lawmakers and district party chairpersons had been demanding his nomination. <<> After the nomination results were announced, Democratic Party Strategic Planning Committee Chair Lee Yeon-hee stated, "I met with (former Deputy Director Kim) today and fully explained the circumstances. I expect him to make a great decision prioritizing the party over personal interests going forward." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr ( 조승래 민주당 사무총장은 이날 경기 하남갑과 평택을, 안산갑 등 3곳의 전략공천 결과를 발표한 뒤 “경기 지역에서 공천을 받지 못한 김 전 부원장을 다른 지역에 공천할 가능성이 있느냐”는 취재진의 질문에 “김 전 부원장이 당과 대통령을 위해 기여했다는 점에서 당 안팎의 많은 분들이 기회를 줘야 한다는 의견이 있었지만, 당은 지방선거와 국회의원 재보선 전체에 끼치는 영향을 종합적으로 판단해 공천하지 않는 게 적절하다고 판단했다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “다른 지역에 대한 공천 검토도 어렵다는 취지로 이해하면 된다”고 덧붙였다. )

item.title: Google to open first AI campus outside London in Seoul… President Lee says "Basic income needed in AI era" (구글, 서울에 런던 외 첫 AI캠퍼스…이 대통령 “AI시대 기본소득 필요”)
item.description:
Google announced on the 27th that it will open an artificial intelligence (AI) campus in South Korea for the first time in the world, excluding London, UK, where Google DeepMind's headquarters is located. President Lee Jae-myung and Demis Hassabis, co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind, met at the presidential office that day and agreed to strengthen AI cooperation between Google and South Korea's research and academic communities. (구글이 구글 딥마인드 본사가 있는 영국 런던을 제외하고 전세계 처음으로 한국에 인공지능(AI) 캠퍼스를 연다고 27일 발표했다. 이재명 대통령과 데미스 허사비스 구글 딥마인드 공동창업자 겸 최고경영자(CEO)는 이날 청와대에서 만나, 구글과 한국 연구계, 학계 등과 인공지능 협력을 강화해나가기로 했다.)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office's policy planning office, held a briefing after accompanying President Lee during the meeting with Hassabis and stated, "Google decided to open a Google AI campus in Seoul within this year to expand collaboration with researchers and startups," adding, "Hassabis also agreed to actively consider dispatching Google researchers to South Korea." Kim proposed dispatching at least about 10 Google researchers, and Hassabis agreed on the spot. Hassabis won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing 'AlphaFold,' an AI model that predicts protein structures. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 이날 이 대통령과 허사비스의 접견 일정 배석 뒤 브리핑을 열고 “구글은 올해 안에 서울에 구글 에이아이 캠퍼스를 개소해 연구자, 스타트업 협력을 확대하기로 했다”며 “허사비스는 구글 연구진을 한국에 파견하는 것도 적극 검토하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 김 실장은 최소 10명 정도의 구글 연구진 파견을 제안했고, 허사비스는 현장에서 동의했다. 허사비스는 단백질 구조 예측 인공지능 모델 ‘알파폴드’를 개발한 공로로 2024년 노벨 화학상을 수상했다.)

Google also agreed to cooperate around the government's 'K-Moonshot Project.' The 'K-Moonshot' is a massive, challenging R&D initiative that uses AI to solve problems in fields like biotechnology, climate, and energy. Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Science and ICT Bae Kyung-hoon met Hassabis that day and signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Google subsidiary DeepMind for joint AI research, talent development, and utilization. (구글은 정부가 추진하는 ‘케이(K)-문샷 프로젝트’를 중심으로도 협력하기로 했다. ‘케이-문샷’은 에이아이를 활용해 바이오·기후·에너지 등 난제를 해결하는 초대형 도전형 연구개발 과제다. 배경훈 부총리 겸 과학기술정보통신부 장관은 이날 허사비스를 만나 구글 자회사인 구글 딥마인드와 에이아이 공동연구, 인재 양성, 활용을 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 맺었다.)

President Lee mentioned his key policy of basic income, asking, "In this AI era, isn't it time we need basic income?" In response, Hassabis "agreed on the necessity while adding that basic services like housing and education should be provided by the state, but market principles should also be integrated," Kim reported. (이 대통령은 자신의 핵심 정책인 기본소득을 언급하며 “에이아이 시대인 지금이야말로 기본소득이 필요한 거 아니냐”고 말했다. 이에 허사비스는 “필요성에 동의하면서 주택, 교육 등 기본 서비스는 국가가 제공하되 자본시장 원리를 접목해야 한다는 것도 추가했다”고 김 실장은 전했다.)

During the meeting, President Lee recalled the 2016 'Match of the Century' between Lee Sedol, a 9-dan Go player, and AlphaGo, saying, "South Korea was deeply shocked when a famous Go player here lost to the AlphaGo created by Demis Hassabis," and asked, "Now, no one can catch up with AlphaGo in the realm of Go, right?" Hassabis replied, "It's extremely difficult now. If humans and AI combine to counter AI, there might be a possibility." (이 대통령은 접견에서 2016년 있었던 이세돌 9단과 알파고의 ‘세기의 대국’을 언급하며 “대한민국에서 바둑기사로 유명한 분이 데미스 허사비스가 만든 알파고에 지는 바람에 대한민국이 엄청난 충격을 받았다”, “이제는 바둑 영역에서 알파고를 아무도 못 따라가겠죠?”라고 물었다. 허사비스는 “이제는 굉장히 어렵다. 사람과 에이아이가 합해져 에이아이를 대항하면 가능성이 있을 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

When President Lee asked, "I often use the Gemini program, but sometimes it does things I didn't ask for. Is that a kind of bug?" Hassabis explained, "If the instructions given by what we call a 'foundation model' are not precise, it can go in a slightly different direction." He added, "When using and developing AI, proper safety measures, or 'guardrails,' must be implemented." (이 대통령이 “제미나이 프로그램을 저도 자주 활용하는데, 가끔은 시키지도 않은 일을 한다. 일종의 버그”냐고 묻자, 허사비스는 “‘파운데이션 모델’이라는 것이 내놓는 지침이 정확하지 않으면 약간 다른 방향으로 갈 수 있다”고 설명했다. 그러면서 “에이아이를 사용하고, 개발할 때는 적절한 안전장치, ‘가드레일’을 반드시 탑재해야 한다”고 말했다.)

In response to President Lee's question about when artificial general intelligence (AGI) might be achieved, Hassabis said, "Within the next five years, possibly as early as 2030, an AGI capable of performing all human cognitive abilities is expected to become visible, and its ripple effects could bring about social changes greater than the Industrial Revolution at a much faster pace." To mark the 10th anniversary of the AlphaGo match, Hassabis gifted President Lee a Go board signed by him and Lee Sedol. (허사비스는 범용 인공지능 도달 시기를 묻는 이 대통령의 질문에 “앞으로 5년 안에, 이르면 2030년에 인간의 모든 인지 능력을 구사하는 범용 인공지능이 가시화될 것으로 전망하며, 그 파급효과는 산업혁명 이상의 큰 사회적 변화를 훨씬 빠른 속도로 몰고 올 수 있다”고 말했다. 허사비스는 알파고 대국 10주년을 기념해 이세돌 9단과 자신의 서명이 담긴 바둑판을 이 대통령에게 선물했다.)

Reporters: Seo Young-ji, Ko Kyung-joo, Kang Jae-gu yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 고경주 강재구 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Meets with Senior Figures to Seek Breakthrough Amid Candidate Disregard (후보들 외면에…장동혁, 원로들 만나 돌파구 모색)
item.description:
With about 30 days left until the June 3 local elections, Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is facing an internal "anti-Jang Dong-hyuk" movement and has been holding private meetings with party seniors instead of visiting campaign sites to support candidates. Jang, who has dismissed calls for his resignation from within the party, appears to be seeking measures to manage the situation. However, candidates for metropolitan and provincial government positions under the People Power Party are pursuing survival strategies, such as forming independent election committees that exclude Jang. (6·3 지방선거를 30여일 앞두고 당내 ‘탈장동혁’ 움직임에 맞닥뜨린 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 후보들을 지원할 현장 방문 일정 대신 당 원로들과의 비공개 회동을 이어가고 있다. 당내 사퇴 요구를 일축한 장 대표가 수습책을 모색하는 것으로 보인다. 그러나 국민의힘 광역단체장 후보들은 장 대표를 배제한 독자 선거대책위원회 구성에 나서는 등 각자도생 방안을 찾고 있다.)

According to a report by *The Hankyoreh* on the 27th, Jang met with former Grand National Party leader Seo Cheong-won on the 24th, Our Republican Party leader Jo Won-jin on the 26th, and former Saenuri Party leader Kim Moo-sung on the same day, in succession. It is known that Jang received advice from these figures on party management strategies. In a phone call with *The Hankyoreh*, former leader Seo said, "Before I go to the U.S., he requested a meeting, so I shared insights based on past experiences." He added, "It seems Jang is contemplating changes in party operations; he might soon reveal his plans." (27일 한겨레 취재 결과, 장 대표는 지난 24일 서청원 전 한나라당 대표와 조원진 우리공화당 대표, 26일 김무성 전 새누리당 대표 등과 잇따라 만났다. 장 대표는 이들로부터 당 운영 방안 등에 대한 조언을 들은 것으로 알려졌다. 서 전 대표는 한겨레와의 통화에서 “미국 가기 전에 먼저 요청이 와서 과거 경험을 바탕으로 얘기를 해줬다”며 “장 대표가 당 운영에 변화를 고민하는 것 같은데, 조만간 직접 구상을 밝히지 않겠나”라고 했다.)

Jang's focus on meetings with senior figures is interpreted as an effort to find a way to address the outpouring of calls for his resignation within the party, stemming from issues such as his refusal to shift the party's direction, internal conflicts over nominations, and controversy over his visit to the U.S. (장 대표가 원로들과의 회동에 집중하는 것은 당 노선 전환 거부, 공천 내홍, 방미 논란 등으로 터져 나온 당내 사퇴 요구에 수습 방안을 찾으려는 것으로 해석된다.)

However, Jang's presence in the local election scene is noticeably fading. Song Eon-seok, the floor leader, recently proposed the role of co-chairperson of the election committee to senior lawmakers like Kim Gi-hyeon, Na Kyung-won, and Ahn Cheol-soo. Yet, there are observations that their acceptance may depend on whether Jang joins the election committee. (그러나 지방선거 국면에서 장 대표의 존재감은 눈에 띄게 사라져 가고 있다. 송언석 원내대표는 최근 김기현·나경원·안철수 등 중진 의원들에게 공동 선대위원장직을 제안했으나, 이들 또한 장 대표의 선대위 합류 여부에 따라 수락 여부가 달라질 수 있다는 관측이 나온다.)

Candidates for metropolitan and provincial positions are distancing themselves from the central party as they jump into election campaigns. On this day, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Busan Mayor Park Hyung-joon, and South Gyeongsang Governor Park Wan-soo registered as preliminary candidates with their regional election commissions. The official candidate registration period with the National Election Commission runs from May 14 to 15, but they have already set aside their incumbent advantages early. Oh stated, "Compared to candidate Jeong Won-oh (from the Democratic Party of Korea), my poll numbers are slightly lower, so I need to work even harder." (광역단체장 후보들은 중앙당과 거리를 두고 선거 운동에 뛰어들고 있다. 이날 오세훈 서울시장과 박형준 부산시장, 박완수 경남지사는 지역선거관리위원회에 예비후보로 등록했다. 중앙선거관리위원회의 후보자등록 신청 기간은 다음달 14~15일까지인데, 일찌감치 현직 프리미엄을 내려놓은 것이다. 오 후보는 “정원오 (더불어민주당) 후보에 비해 여론 조사상 수치가 조금 떨어지기 때문에 더 열심히 해야 되겠다는 마음가짐”이라고 했다.)

The previous day, candidate Park Hyung-joon appointed Kim Moon-soo, former Minister of Employment and Labor and the People Power Party's presidential candidate last year, as honorary chairperson of his election committee, initiating a committee aimed at consolidating conservative support. A lawmaker from the Busan region commented, "Since Mayor Park was confirmed as the candidate, the conservative consolidation trend has continued, so this move is meant to solidify it." (전날 박형준 후보는 지난해 대통령 선거에서 국민의힘 후보였던 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관을 명예선대위원장으로 추대하며 보수 결집을 겨냥한 선대위 구성에 돌입했다. 부산 지역의 한 의원은 “박 시장으로 후보가 확정된 뒤 보수 결집 흐름이 이어지고 있기 때문에 쐐기를 박으려는 것”이라고 했다.)

Gyeonggi Province is also forming an independent election committee, keeping its distance from Jang. On that day, lawmaker Kim Eun-hye (from Seongnam Bundang-gu, Gyeonggi) announced on Facebook, "I propose a 'Gyeonggi Province Melting Pot Election Committee,' where residents of 31 cities and counties will serve as committee chairs." (경기도도 장 대표와 거리를 두는 독자 선대위 구성에 나선다. 이날 김은혜 의원(경기 성남 분당을)은 페이스북에서 “31개 시·군 도민이 선대위원장이 되는 ‘경기도 용광로 선대위’를 제안한다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Jong Un: "New History of Blood-Written North Korea-Russia Relations"... Discusses Signing 5-Year Military Cooperation with Russian Defense Minister (김정은 “피로 쓴 북-러 새 역사”…러 국방과 5개년 군사협력 체결 논의)
item.description:
North Korea and Russia, marking the "1st anniversary of the recapture of Kursk," reaffirmed their blood-alliance ties and discussed military cooperation plans, including a "five-year military cooperation plan." This is interpreted as a signal that the two countries, which have drawn closer through the Ukraine war, are seeking mid- to long-term military cooperation. While the security burden on the Korean Peninsula is expected to increase, cautious voices exist that the actual level of cooperation remains to be seen. (북한과 러시아가 ‘쿠르스크 탈환 1주년’을 계기로 양국의 혈맹 관계를 재확인하고, ‘5개년 군사협력 계획’ 등 군사협력 방안을 논의했다. 우크라이나 전쟁을 통해 밀착했던 양국이 중장기적 군사협력을 모색하는 신호라는 해석이 나온다. 한반도의 안보 부담이 커질 전망이지만, 실질적인 협력 수준은 지켜봐야 한다는 신중론도 있다.)

The Korean Central News Agency reported on the 27th that North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un and Russian Defense Minister Andrei Belousov met on the 26th and exchanged views on the international situation and mutual interests between North Korea and Russia. The Russian TASS news agency reported that Minister Belousov informed Chairman Kim that Russia is ready to sign a mutual military cooperation plan between Russia and North Korea for 2027-2031, but the Korean Central News Agency did not convey this content. The agency only stated that "a series of issues were discussed to further solidify, strengthen, and develop political-military cooperation and coordination between the two countries (North Korea and Russia)." (조선중앙통신은 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 안드레이 벨로우소프 국방장관이 지난 26일 면담하고, 국제 정세와 북-러 상호 관심사에 대한 의견을 교환했다고도 27일 보도했다. 러시아 타스 통신은 벨로우소프 장관이 김 위원장에게 2027~2031년 러시아와 북한 간 상호 군사협력 계획을 체결할 준비가 돼 있다고 밝혔다고 보도했지만, 조선중앙통신은 이런 내용을 전하진 않았다. 통신은 다만 “조로(북·러) 두 나라 사이의 정치군사적 협력과 협조를 더욱 공고히 하고 가일층 강화 발전시켜 나가기 위한 일련의 문제들이 토의되었다”고 전했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun also prominently covered the completion of a memorial hall marking the first anniversary of Russia's liberation operation in Kursk, in which North Korean forces participated. Chairman Kim Jong Un, who attended the completion ceremony of the "Commemorative Hall for Meritorious Feats in Overseas Military Operations" held on the 26th, emphasized North Korea-Russia relations as a "blood alliance" and the sacrifices of the North Korean military, stating in his speech, "We have inscribed a new history of North Korea-Russia friendship written in blood, a new history of justice achieved through blood." The ceremony was attended by Vyacheslav Volodin, Chairman of the Russian State Duma, and Minister Belousov. (노동신문은 북한이 참전한 러시아 쿠르스크 해방작전 1주년을 맞아 열린 기념관 완공 소식도 이날 대대적으로 보도했다. 26일 열린 ‘해외군사작전 전투위훈기념관’ 준공식에 참석한 김정은 위원장은 연설에서 “피로 쓴 조로(북·러) 친선의 새 역사, 피로써 전취한 정의의 새 역사를 새겼다”며 ‘혈맹’으로서의 북-러 관계와 북한군의 희생을 강조했다. 준공식에는 뱌체슬라프 볼로딘 러시아 하원(국가두마) 의장과 벨로우소프 장관이 참여했다.)

Experts forecast that the discussions on signing a military cooperation plan between North Korea and Russia signal a transition to an institutionalized, mid- to long-term military alliance relationship. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said, "If previous (North Korea-Russia) cooperation was a short-term concept focused on Ukraine, it is now being elevated to a regular five-year cooperation structure," and "Beyond the comprehensive strategic partnership agreement signed in June 2024, there is also the possibility of moving toward a specific military operational agreement." (전문가들은 북-러의 군사협력 계획 체결 논의가 제도화된 중장기 군사동맹의 관계로의 전환을 예고한다고 내다봤다. 홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “기존의 (북-러) 협력이 우크라이나에 초점을 맞춘 단기적 협력 개념이었다면, 이제는 5년 단위 정례적 협력 구조로 격상하게 되는 것”이라며 “(2024년 6월) 맺은 포괄적 전략적 동반자 관계를 넘어 구체적인 군사운용협정으로 나아갈 가능성도 있다”고 했다.)

Specific cooperation measures under discussion range from simple exchange activities like inter-unit communication to joint ground force military exercises, naval training through Russian fleet port calls, and military education. What is concerning is defense and technology cooperation involving nuclear forces and conventional weapons. Jang Yong-seok, a visiting researcher at Seoul National University's Institute for Peace and Unification Studies, stated, "North Korea is strengthening its conventional weapons to integrate nuclear and conventional forces, and the possibility of cooperation for this is most concerning," adding, "If military exercises between Russia and North Korea occur, it could increase military tensions in conjunction with ROK-U.S. and ROK-U.S.-Japan joint exercises." (구체적인 협력 방안으론 부대 간 소통과 같은 단순 교류 활동부터 연합 형태의 지상군 군사 훈련, 러시아 함대 기항을 통한 해군 훈련, 군사 교육 등이 거론된다. 우려되는 건 핵전력과 재래식 무기를 둘러싼 방산·기술 협력이다. 장용석 서울대 통일평화연구원 객원연구원은 “북한은 핵전력과 재래식 전력을 통합 운용하는 방향으로 재래식 무기를 강화하고 있는데, 이를 위한 협력 가능성이 가장 우려된다”며 “또 러시아와 북한의 군사 훈련이 이뤄지면, 한·미, 한·미·일 연합 훈련과 맞물려 군사적 긴장이 높아질 수 있다”고 말했다.)

However, the extent of practical cooperation between North Korea and Russia remains uncertain at this point. Visiting Researcher Jang Yong-seok said, "North Korea and China do not conduct military exercises, and if Russia sets foot in this region through North Korea, it could also create a power struggle between China and Russia," but added, "There are various ways of cooperation, and it remains to be seen how much it will actually help North Korea's (defense) building." (다만 북-러 사이에 얼마나 실질적인 협력이 오갈진 현재로선 불확실하다. 장용석 객원연구원은 “북한과 중국은 군사 훈련을 하지 않는데, 러시아가 북한을 통해 이 지역에 발을 들이게 되면 중국과 러시아의 힘겨루기 현상도 생길 수 있다”면서도 “일단 협력의 방식은 여러가지이고, 북한이 필요로 하는 (국방력) 건설에 실제 얼마나 도움이 될지는 지켜봐야 할 일”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo joins ‘Busan Big Match’…Han Dong-hoon and Park Min-shik’s unification emerges as variable (하정우 가세한 ‘부산 빅매치’…한동훈·박민식 단일화가 변수)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, the Presidential Office’s Senior Secretary for AI Future Planning, expressed his resignation on the 27th, officially announcing his candidacy in the by-election for the Busan Buk-gu Gap National Assembly seat. This has significantly increased the likelihood of a three-way race involving Senior Secretary Ha, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik, who is being considered as the People Power Party’s candidate, and independent former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon. While the need for unification between former Minister Park and former leader Han is being raised within the People Power Party, both are drawing a line, intensifying the competition. <<> The Democratic Party of Korea is expecting a ‘mutual boost effect’ as Senior Secretary Ha, who is succeeding lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo in the district, and lawmaker Jeon, who is running for Busan Mayor, campaign together. A Busan city party official told The Hankyoreh, “If three-term lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo and the new face Ha Jung-woo, who will succeed him, run together, there could be a synergy effect.” Born in 1977, Senior Secretary Ha is a local native who attended elementary, middle, and high school in Busan. He shares a connection with lawmaker Jeon as a senior-junior relationship with a six-year gap from Busan Gudeok High School. <<> The variable is whether there will be unification between the People Power Party’s candidate and independent former leader Han. When Media Tomato asked 802 adults residing in Busan Buk-gu Gap, commissioned by News Tomato, on the 24th and 25th, “Who would you vote for in this region’s by-election?” 35.5% of respondents chose Senior Secretary Ha, 28.5% chose former leader Han, and 26.0% chose former Minister Park. If former leader Han and former Minister Park unify, the combined approval rating would be 54.5%, forming a structure ahead of Senior Secretary Ha (survey using wireless automated response method. For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). <<> Within the People Power Party, concerned about the dispersion of conservative votes, there are calls for no nomination or candidate unification. A lawmaker from Busan said, “In Busan, the Democratic Party’s fixed vote is 38%, and the People Power Party’s is 40%, so in a three-way race, the Democratic Party is advantageous. If no nomination is difficult, there must at least be candidate unification.” Bae Hyun-jin, a lawmaker from the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, said on SBS Radio this day, “Virtually, the People Power Party should either not nominate or support former leader Han Dong-hoon, who is effectively our candidate.” <<> However, both former Minister Park and former leader Han are strongly drawing a line on the issue of unification, raising questions about whether future negotiations are possible. Former Minister Park appeared on the Maeil Shinmun YouTube channel this day and said, “Even if the party leadership tells me to ‘unify,’ I will not comply.” He had previously criticized former leader Han as an “intruder.” Former leader Han’s side told The Hankyoreh, “Our approval ratings are rising, so unification can naturally happen through votes.” The two met at a total alumni association sports event held at Busan Buk-gu Gupo Elementary School the previous day, but only briefly shook hands without conversation and then left. Park Deok-heum, chairman of the People Power Party’s nomination management committee, said in a briefing at the party office in Yeouido, Seoul, the previous day, “Regarding additional by-elections, I personally think the principle should be a primary.” Within the People Power Party, former KBS journalist Lee Young-pung is also showing intent to run in the Buk-gu Gap election and is covering the region. <<> A Democratic Party official predicted, “If opposition unification does not materialize, we have a winning chance. In a three-way race, the approval ratings of former leader Han and former Minister Park will diverge, and the key will be whether former Minister Park holds out amid the wasted vote controversy.” <<> Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr and Koh Han-sol Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (하정우 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석이 27일 사의를 표명하면서 부산 북구갑 국회의원 보궐선거 출마를 공식화했다. 이에 따라 하 수석과 국민의힘 후보로 거론되는 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관, 무소속 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표의 3파전으로 선거가 치러질 가능성이 커졌다. 국민의힘 내부에서는 박 전 장관과 한 전 대표 간 단일화 필요성이 제기되지만, 두 사람 모두 선을 그으며 경쟁이 격화하는 양상이다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Nominates Candidates for Three By-elections in Gyeonggi Province… Excludes Kim Yong, President Lee’s Closest Aide (민주, 경기 국회의원 재보궐 3곳 공천…이 대통령 최측근 김용 제외)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea on the 27th announced strategic nominations for three by-elections to be held alongside the June 3 local elections: former Gangwon Governor Lee Gwang-jae for the Gyeonggi Hanam-gap National Assembly by-election, former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul re-election, and former lawmaker Kim Nam-gook for the Gyeonggi Ansan-gap by-election. On the same day, Ha Jeong-woo, the presidential secretary for artificial intelligence (AI) future planning, expressed his intention to resign from the presidential office and effectively formalized his candidacy for the Busan Buk-gu National Assembly by-election. (더불어민주당이 27일 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 경기 하남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 이광재 전 강원지사, 경기 평택을 재선거에 김용남 전 의원, 경기 안산갑 보궐선거에 김남국 전 의원을 전략공천했다. 이날 하정우 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석은 청와대에 사의를 표명하고, 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 출마를 사실상 공식화했다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun announced in a briefing that the Democratic Party held a strategic nomination committee meeting and a closed supreme council meeting that afternoon to decide on the nominations for the three National Assembly by-elections in Gyeonggi Province. Gyeonggi Hanam-gap became a by-election district after lawmaker Choo Mi-ae was confirmed as the party’s candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor. Senior spokesperson Kang said, "Former Governor Lee is a heavyweight politician who has served as a three-term lawmaker and a metropolitan government head, with experience winning even in conservative strongholds and a deep understanding of issues in the Seoul metropolitan area." (민주당은 이날 오후 전략공천관리위원회 및 비공개 최고위원회의를 열어 경기 지역 3곳의 국회의원 재보궐 공천을 결정했다고 강준현 수석대변인이 브리핑을 통해 밝혔다. 경기 하남갑은 추미애 의원이 경기지사 후보로 확정되면서 보궐선거가 열리게 된 곳이다. 강 수석대변인은 “이 전 지사는 3선 의원과 광역단체장을 지낸 중량감 있는 정치인으로 보수 텃밭에서도 승리한 경험과 수도권 현안에 대한 높은 이해도를 두루 갖췄다”고 말했다.)

Regarding former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, who was strategically nominated for Pyeongtaek-eul, Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "He has a broad support base that transcends factions, giving him strong competitiveness in the main election even in tough districts." Kim previously served in the People Power Party and the Reform Party before switching to the Democratic Party. Pyeongtaek-eul now features a multi-way race with candidates including Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party; Kim Jae-yeon, leader of the Progressive Party; former People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong; and Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of the Liberty and Innovation Party. For former lawmaker Kim Nam-kook, strategically nominated for Gyeonggi Ansan-gap, Kang noted, "He has a solid organizational base and a deep understanding of local issues, built during his tenure as a lawmaker representing the Ansan area." (강 수석대변인은 평택을에 전략공천된 김용남 전 의원에 대해 “진영을 뛰어넘는 폭넓은 지지 기반으로 험지에서도 승리할 수 있는 높은 본선 경쟁력을 갖추고 있다”고 했다. 김 전 의원은 국민의힘, 개혁신당에서 활동하다 민주당으로 당적을 옮겼다. 평택을은 조국 조국혁신당 대표, 김재연 진보당 대표, 유의동 국민의힘 전 의원, 황교안 자유와혁신 대표가 출마해 다자 구도를 형성하고 있다. 경기 안산갑에 전략공천된 김남국 전 의원에 대해선 “과거 안산을 지역구로 국회의원을 역임하며 다져온 탄탄한 조직력과 높은 현안 이해도를 갖고 있다”고 했다.)

However, the Democratic Party decided not to nominate Kim Yong, former deputy director of the Democratic Research Institute and a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung, who had expressed his intention to run in Gyeonggi Province, for this by-election. (다만 민주당은 경기 지역 출마 의지를 드러냈던 이재명 대통령의 최측근 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장은 이번 재보궐선거에 공천하지 않기로 결정했다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, presidential spokesperson Jeon Eun-soo expressed his intention to resign from the presidential office and is expected to announce his candidacy for the Chungnam Asan-eul by-election. (한편, 이날 전은수 청와대 대변인은 청와대에 사의를 표명했는데 충남 아산을 보궐선거에 출사표를 던질 예정이다.)

item.title: 8th anniversary of Panmunjom Declaration… Former President Moon: "Kim Jong-un and Trump must boldly sit face to face" (판문점선언 8주년…문 전 대통령 “김정은·트럼프, 과감하게 마주 앉아야”)
item.description:
On the 8th anniversary of the Panmunjom Declaration, former President Moon Jae-in on the 27th urged North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un, saying, "I hope you will boldly sit down with U.S. President Donald Trump, who has shown a willingness to engage in dialogue." (문재인 전 대통령이 판문점선언 8주년인 27일 김정은 북한 국무위원장을 향해 “대화 의지를 보인 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 과감하게 마주 앉길 바란다”고 말했다.)

Attending the 4·27 Panmunjom Declaration 8th anniversary ceremony held at the National Assembly that day, former President Moon stated, "I urge Chairman Kim. Building up military power and raising walls of isolation and severance cannot guarantee true security," adding, "I hope you can use the improvement of inter-Korean relations, as we did eight years ago, as a bridge to advance North Korea-U.S. dialogue." (문 전 대통령은 이날 국회에서 열린 4·27 판문점선언 8주년 기념식에 참석해 “김 위원장에게 촉구한다. 군사력을 증강하며 고립과 단절의 벽을 높이는 것으로는 진정한 안보를 보장받을 수 없다”며 “8년 전처럼 남북 관계 개선을 북·미 대화로 나아가는 가교로 삼기를 바란다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "I ask that you return to the original spirit of the 4·27 Panmunjom summit, open the door to dialogue in a forward-looking manner, and together with the Lee Jae-myung administration, redraw the dream of 'a Korean Peninsula of peace and prosperity' and move forward as a proud member of the international community." He also said, "The transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) is also a task that can no longer be delayed. Independent national defense and the transfer of wartime OPCON are by no means a weakening of the (South Korea-U.S.) alliance." <<> Previously, on April 27, 2018, former President Moon and Chairman Kim adopted the 'Panmunjom Declaration for Peace, Prosperity, and Unification of the Korean Peninsula' through their inter-Korean summit at Panmunjom, which included commitments to improve inter-Korean relations and establish a peace regime. <<> Addressing President Trump, former President Moon said, "The Korean Peninsula issue is a core national interest of the United States that must never slip down the priority list, and a watershed for global peace," adding, "I hope you will exercise your unique decisiveness and wisdom to bring North Korea back to the table of dialogue." He further expressed, "I look forward to seeing you complete the fruits of peace that were left unfinished in your first term during your second term, demonstrating a historic peace leadership." <<> Regarding the current state of inter-Korean relations, former President Moon emphasized, "Through the Yoon Suk-yeol administration's regressive North Korea policy, the Korean Peninsula peace process has been halted, and the rift between the two Koreas has deepened further," stressing that "the Lee Jae-myung administration must wisely overcome the limitations of the past and begin a new 'peace relay race'." He reiterated, "The transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) is also a task that can no longer be delayed. Independent national defense and the transfer of wartime OPCON are by no means a weakening of the (South Korea-U.S.) alliance." <<> Meanwhile, ahead of the ceremony, former President Moon, along with National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, inspected the broken glass panes caused by martial law troops entering the main building during the December 3 emergency martial law incident. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (이어 “4·27 판문점 회담의 초심으로 돌아가 전향적으로 대화의 문을 열고 이재명 정부와 함께 ‘평화와 번영의 한반도’의 꿈을 다시 그려나가며 국제사회의 당당한 일원으로 나아갈 것을 당부한다”며 “전시작전권 전환도 더는 미룰 수 없는 과제다. 자주국방과 전시작전권 전환은 결코 (한-미)동맹의 약화가 아니다”고 했다.)

item.title: About 80 lawmakers from the ruling bloc to send protest letter to U.S. over 'Coupang incident' (범여권 의원 80여명, 미국에 ‘쿠팡 사태’ 항의서한 보낸다)
item.description:
Lawmakers from the ruling bloc, including the Democratic Party of Korea, will send a protest letter to the U.S. administration, which has pressured South Korea by suspending high-level security negotiations while demanding resolution of safety issues for Coupang Inc. Chairman Kim Beom-seok. The letter will convey the stance that the U.S. administration's demands constitute a 'violation of judicial sovereignty'. (더불어민주당 등 범여권 의원들이 김범석 쿠팡아이엔씨(Inc) 의장의 신변 안전 문제 해결을 요구하며 고위급 안보 협상 중단을 압박한 미국 행정부를 향해 항의서한을 발송한다. 서한에는 미 행정부 쪽 요구가 ‘사법주권 침해’란 입장이 담긴다.)

On the 27th, Democratic Party lawmakers Kim Nam-geun and Park Hong-bae, among others, requested lawmakers from the ruling bloc, including the Democratic Party, the Fatherland Innovation Party, the Progressive Party, and the Social Democratic Party, to 'sign on to the protest letter against the U.S. violation of judicial sovereignty'. As of around 8 p.m. that day, 83 lawmakers had participated in the signing, with the number expected to rise further. (27일 김남근·박홍배 민주당 의원 등은 민주당과 조국혁신당, 진보당, 사회민주당 등 범여권 의원들에게 ‘미국의 사법주권 침해 항의서한 연명’을 요청했다. 연명에 참여한 의원들은 이날 저녁 8시께 83명으로, 더 늘어날 수 있다.)

The letter points out that the 'Coupang incident' is an unprecedented case where an individual businessman's legal risks were linked to inter-state negotiations, stating that this constitutes a "clear violation of judicial sovereignty." It is also reported to include the observation that such a stance could have a significant negative impact on South Korea's labor rights and fair economic order. (서한에는 ‘쿠팡 사태’가 개별 기업인의 사법 리스크를 국가 간 협상과 결부시킨 전례 없는 사례임을 지적하며, 이는 “명백한 사법주권 침해”라는 내용이 담긴다. 아울러 이런 입장은 한국의 노동권과 공정경제 질서에 부정적 영향을 미칠 우려가 크다는 취지의 지적도 포함된 것으로 전해졌다.)

However, Rep. Kim drew a line, noting that this move is not a party-level initiative. Rep. Kim explained, "Given that diplomacy with the U.S. must also be considered, it's difficult for the government or the party to officially step forward, but there has been a consensus that even individual lawmakers should protest the U.S. actions." (다만 김 의원은 이런 움직임이 당 차원의 행보는 아니라고 선을 그었다. 김 의원은 “미국과 외교도 고려해야 하는 만큼 정부나 당이 공식적으로 나서긴 어렵지만, 개별 의원들 차원에서라도 미국 쪽 움직임에 항의해야 한다는 의견이 모인 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Earlier, National Security Office Director Wi Seong-rak acknowledged on the 23rd (local time) at the Hanoi Press Center in Vietnam that the U.S. State Department and Congress had recently pressured the South Korean government by linking the Coupang incident to halting high-level consultations on security areas such as South Korea's construction of nuclear-powered submarines, as well as uranium enrichment and reprocessing. Additionally, 54 members of the U.S. House Republican Study Committee (RSC) had sent a letter to South Korean Ambassador to the U.S., Kang Kyung-wha, demanding "the immediate cessation of discriminatory regulatory measures against U.S. companies operating in South Korea." Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (앞서 위성락 국가안보실장은 지난 23일(현지시각) 베트남 하노이 프레스센터에서 최근 미 국무부와 의회 등이 쿠팡 사태를 고리로 한국의 핵추진잠수함 건조와 우라늄 농축·재처리 등 안보 분야에 대한 고위급 협의를 멈추는 등 우리 정부를 압박한 사실을 인정했다. 미국 연방하원 공화당 의원 모임인 ‘공화당 연구위원회’(RSC) 소속 의원 54명도 강경화 주미대사에게 서한을 보내 “한국에서 영업하는 미국 기업들에 대한 차별적 규제 조처를 즉각 중단하라”고 요구한 바 있다. 최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam's dive into Pyeongtaek B... Interest in opposition bloc unification with Cho Kuk and Kim Jae-yeon (김용남 뛰어든 평택을…조국·김재연과 범여권 단일화 관심)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced its strategic nominations for three constituencies (Hanam Gap, Pyeongtaek B, and Ansan Gap) in the June 3 by-elections on the 27th, finalizing all candidates for the Seoul metropolitan area by-elections. With former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam confirmed as the Democratic Party candidate for the key battleground of Pyeongtaek B, the possibility of unification within the opposition bloc with the Rebuilding Korea Party and the Progressive Party has emerged as a variable. <<> On this day, the Democratic Party held consecutive meetings of the Strategic Nomination Management Committee and the Supreme Council, then announced the nomination of former Gangwon Province Governor Lee Gwang-jae for Hanam Gap, former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam for Pyeongtaek B, and spokesperson Kim Nam-kook for Ansan Gap. <<> Senior Democratic Party spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun told reporters at the National Assembly that regarding Lee's nomination for Hanam Gap, "We judged him to be the most competitive candidate, with experience winning even in conservative strongholds and an understanding of the metropolitan area." Hanam Gap is where lawmaker Choo Mi-ae narrowly beat the then-People Power Party candidate by just 1,199 votes (1.17 percentage points) in the last general election. The Democratic Party appears to be planning to deploy Lee, a three-term lawmaker (17th, 18th, 21st assemblies) with experience as Gangwon governor, to lead the overall Gyeonggi Province elections. Regarding the nomination of Kim Nam-kook, former Blue House official, for Ansan Gap, he said, "He has the deepest understanding of President Lee Jae-myung's governing philosophy." <<> Attention is focused on Pyeongtaek B, where opposition bloc competition is set to intensify, with Rebuilding Korea Party leader Cho Kuk and Progressive Party co-leader Kim Jae-yeon having already declared their intentions to run there early on. Senior spokesperson Kang explained the placement of Kim Yong-nam, who moved from the People Power Party and the Reform Party to the Democratic Party, in Pyeongtaek B, saying, "We saw him as the most suitable candidate in terms of conservative appeal." This appears to be a consideration of Pyeongtaek B being a relatively weaker region for Democratic Party support. <<> In a post on Facebook after his nomination was confirmed, Kim said, "I will ensure that a candidate from a party that still avoids reflecting on the insurrection is not elected," adding, "To prevent damage to the opposition bloc cooperation that has continued through the last presidential election and various policy issues, I will open my heart and discuss and deliberate together with candidates Cho Kuk and Kim Jae-yeon, who started ahead." This is interpreted as a signal that he will pursue discussions on opposition bloc unification to prevent the election of People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong and Liberty and Innovation Party leader Hwang Kyo-ahn. <<> However, whether the unification discussion process will proceed smoothly remains uncertain. On the same day, when asked by reporters about the direction of opposition bloc unification negotiations for the Pyeongtaek B by-election and the Ulsan and Sejong mayoral elections, Senior spokesperson Kang said, "There is no such word as 'concession'." This is read as meaning there will be no 'district concession' for Cho Kuk. Rebuilding Party Senior Spokesperson Park Byung-un also told *The Hankyoreh*, "We will engage in a clear competition over which candidate better aligns with the spirit and values of the democratic and progressive camp." The Rebuilding Party has also been highlighting Kim's past actions during his time in the People Power Party. On the 23rd, Rebuilding Party Supreme Council member Shin Jang-sik mentioned that Kim had intensely raised suspicions about private equity funds during the so-called 'Cho Kuk scandal' in 2019, saying, "He must apologize first." <<> Meanwhile, according to a poll (wireless automated response survey) of 703 residents of the Pyeongtaek B district conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) for *Pressian* on the 25th and 26th, if Kim Yong-nam runs as the Democratic Party candidate, approval ratings were: Cho Kuk (title omitted) 23.4%, Kim Yong-nam 21.4%, Yoo Eui-dong 21.2%, Hwang Kyo-ahn 12.0%, and Kim Jae-yeon 9.4% (see the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website for details). <<> Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 27일 6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거 경기 3개 지역(하남갑·평택을·안산갑)에 대한 전략공천을 발표하면서 수도권 재보궐선거 후보를 모두 확정했다. 주요 격전지로 꼽히는 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 김용남 전 의원이 민주당 후보로 확정되며 향후 조국혁신당, 진보당의 범여권 단일화 여부가 변수로 떠오른다.)

item.title: Kim Yong Tripped by Judicial Risk… Democratic Party Excludes Him from Candidacy, Fearing Backlash on Overall Election Prospects (사법리스크에 발목 잡힌 김용…민주 전체 판세 ‘역풍’ 우려 공천배제)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea decided on the 27th not to nominate Kim Yong, a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung and former vice director of the Democratic Research Institute, for the National Assembly by-elections to be held concurrently with the June 3 local elections. This decision was made on the judgment that Kim’s “judicial risk” would negatively impact the overall election landscape in the metropolitan area. (더불어민주당은 27일 이재명 대통령 측근인 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장을 6·3 지방선거와 같이 치러지는 국회의원 재보궐선거에 공천하지 않기로 했다. 김 전 부원장의 ‘사법 리스크’가 수도권 선거 전체 판세에 악영향을 끼칠 것이라는 판단에서다.)

After announcing the strategic nominations for three Gyeonggi districts (Hanam-gap, Pyeongtaek-eul, and Ansan-gap) for the National Assembly by-elections, Democratic Party Secretary General Jo Seung-rae told reporters, “While many inside and outside the party believed that former Vice Director Kim, given his contributions to the party and the president, should be given an opportunity, we concluded after a comprehensive assessment of the impact on the overall election that it is appropriate not to nominate him.” Secretary General Jo added, “This should be understood to mean that considering him for other districts is also difficult.” (조승래 민주당 사무총장은 이날 국회의원 재보궐선거 경기 3개 지역(하남갑·평택을·안산갑)에 대한 전략공천을 발표한 뒤 기자들에게 “김 전 부원장이 당과 대통령을 위해 기여했다는 점에서 당 안팎의 많은 분들이 기회를 줘야 한다는 의견이 있었지만, 선거 전체에 끼치는 영향을 종합적으로 판단해 공천하지 않는 것이 적절하다는 판단을 하게 됐다”고 밝혔다. 조 사무총장은 “다른 지역에 대한 공천 검토도 어렵단 취지로 이해하면 된다”고 덧붙였다.)

Former Vice Director Kim received a five-year prison sentence in his second trial on charges of receiving illegal political funds from a private developer involved in the Daejang-dong project. He was released on bail in August last year and is awaiting a Supreme Court ruling. Initially, Kim had hoped for nomination in Gyeonggi’s Hanam-gap or Ansan-gap, but the Democratic Party leadership was negative about his candidacy, emphasizing “the public’s perspective.” However, many pro-Lee lawmakers and district committee chairs pressured the leadership, successively issuing statements urging his nomination, claiming that “former Vice Director Kim is a victim of a manipulated indictment by the prosecution.” The Democratic Party ultimately appears to have judged that nominating Kim would adversely affect public sentiment in the metropolitan area. (김 전 부원장은 대장동 개발 민간사업자에게 불법 정치자금을 수수한 혐의 등으로 2심에서 징역 5년형을 받았다가 지난해 8월 보석으로 풀려났고, 대법원 판결을 앞두고 있다. 애초 김 전 부원장은 경기 하남갑, 안산갑 공천을 희망했으나 민주당 지도부는 ‘국민 눈높이’를 강조하며 공천에 부정적이었다. 그러나 친명(친이재명)계 의원 상당수와 당협위원장들이 “김 전 부원장은 검찰 조작기소의 피해자”라며 잇달아 공천 촉구 입장을 내며 당 지도부를 압박했다. 민주당은 김 전 부원장을 공천할 경우 수도권 민심에 악영향을 줄 것이라고 최종 판단한 것으로 보인다.)

Lee Yeon-hee, chair of the Democratic Party’s Strategic Planning Committee, said, “We thoroughly explained the circumstances to Kim, and we expect him to make a great decision of putting the party before self in the future.” (이연희 민주당 전략기획위원장은 “(김 전 부원장에게) 전후 사정을 잘 설명했고, 앞으로 선당후사의 큰 결단을 내려줄 것으로 기대한다”고 말했다.)

It is reported that former Vice Director Kim will hold a press conference at the National Assembly on the 28th to announce his acceptance of the party’s decision, stating that he will “serve as a loyal soldier in the ranks.” (김 전 부원장은 28일 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 ‘백의종군하겠다’며 당의 결정에 승복하겠다는 입장을 밝힐 것으로 알려졌다.)

Some within the party speculate that Kim might move to Seongnam Bundang-gap in Gyeonggi, the former constituency of Lee Kwang-jae, former governor of Gangwon Province, to prepare for the next general election. (당 일각에선 김 전 부원장이 이광재 전 강원지사의 지역구이던 경기 성남분당갑으로 옮겨 다음 총선을 준비할 것이란 전망이 나온다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Dongwha Group Chairman's 'Disguised Gift' Suspicions... Transferred 56 Billion Won Worth of Shares to Wife and Children ([단독] 동화그룹 회장 ‘변칙 증여’ 정황…부인·자녀에 560억대 주식 양도)
item.description:
Evidence has been confirmed that Dongwha Group Chairman Seung Myung-ho disguised a transfer of 56.6 billion won worth of shares to his family as a sale to avoid taxes in a bid to evade gift taxes. Tax authorities have admitted to inadequate investigations and belatedly indicated they would review imposing gift taxes. <<> According to a comprehensive report by The Hankyoreh on the 27th, the Board of Audit and Inspection, during a regular audit of the National Tax Service conducted in May-June last year, found that Chairman Seung had entered into share transfer agreements with his spouse and three children to avoid gift taxes, and pointed out that whether gift taxes should be imposed needed to be reviewed. <<> Chairman Seung signed transfer agreements in April-June 2016 to sell a 20% stake in Dongwha International, the Hong Kong-based holding company of Dongwha Group, to his family for 56.68 billion won. At that time, the family paid a down payment of 6 billion won, about 10% of the total amount, and treated the remaining over 50 billion won as borrowed money by entering into a loan agreement (interest rate 4.6%, term 1 year) with Chairman Seung. Later, around the contract maturity date in May 2017, Chairman Seung set up an agreement to lend this money interest-free for one year, and subsequently signed 'interest-free loan' agreements each year for nine years until the audit in 2025. The family appears to have barely repaid the amount. In response, Dongwha Group stated that the transfer of share ownership was "part of a management succession" and argued that "whether the loan constitutes a gift should be judged comprehensively based on the contract between the parties and the fact of interest payments, and currently, most of the borrowed funds have been repaid," claiming there was no tax avoidance intent. Dongwha Group focuses on timber and chemical businesses and entered the media industry after acquiring The Korea Times in 2015. <<> However, the Board of Audit and Inspection suspected it was a gift rather than a typical transfer. The board stated, "The transferor (Chairman Seung) transferred ownership to the transferee (family) before even receiving payment for the property, and handled it interest-free, meaning no consideration was exchanged at all. This cannot be seen as a normal transaction between third parties." Furthermore, it judged that the funds partially repaid by the family were raised by selling shares received from Chairman Seung, so it did not meet the 'grounds for excluding the presumption of a gift' that would allow considering that they procured the funds independently. Regarding the claim of no tax avoidance intent, the Board of Audit and Inspection pointed out, "This is an excuse for management succession without the burden of gift taxes." <<> A National Tax Service official told The Hankyoreh that day, "We will review imposing gift taxes on Chairman Seung's family." The Yongsan Tax Office, which conducted a tax investigation in 2020, initially accepted Dongwha Group's claims and judged it as a transfer, but after the audit stated, "It is deemed subject to gift taxes. We will impose gift taxes based on the standards of June 2016," issuing a confirmation statement to the Board of Audit and Inspection. The Yongsan Tax Office reported that the amount of gift tax due is approximately 49.6 billion won. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (동화그룹 승명호 회장이 가족에게 566억원 규모의 주식을 넘기는 과정에서 세금을 피하기 위해 양도로 위장한 ‘변칙 증여’를 시도한 정황이 확인됐다. 세무당국은 부실 조사를 인정하고 뒤늦게 증여세 과세를 검토하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

item.title: Swing Voters at 30% in Battlegrounds…A 'Variable' That Could Decide the Election (격전지 무당층 30%대…여야 승패 가를 ‘변수’)
item.description:
With the June 3 local elections just over a month away, the proportion of swing voters hovering around 30% is emerging as a major variable that could decide the election landscape in the key battleground of the Yeongnam region. Analysis suggests that some conservative-leaning voters, who turned away from the People Power Party (PPP) following the December 3 insurrection incident, are now observing the election as unaffiliated voters. The Democratic Party (DP) is wary of a 'landslide victory' narrative in the local elections and is focused on avoiding mistakes that could alienate swing voters. Meanwhile, amid internal strife over candidate nominations and controversy over leader Jang Dong-hyuk's 'visit to the U.S.,' PPP candidates for metropolitan mayoral positions are distancing themselves from the central party to target swing voters. (6·3 지방선거가 한달여 앞으로 다가오면서 30% 안팎을 넘나드는 무당층 비율이 영남권 격전지 선거 판도를 가를 주요 변수로 떠오르고 있다. 12·3 내란 사태로 국민의힘에 등을 돌린 보수 성향 유권자 일부가 무당층으로 선거를 관망하고 있다는 분석이 나온다. 더불어민주당은 지방선거 ‘낙승론’을 경계하며 무당층에 반감을 살 만한 실책을 피하는 데 집중하고 있다. 국민의힘은 공천 내홍과 장동혁 대표의 ‘방미 논란’ 속에 광역단체장 후보들이 중앙당과 거리를 두고 무당층 공략에 나섰다.)

According to national polls released on the 27th by organizations such as Gallup Korea, the proportion of unaffiliated voters—those who answered 'no supporting party,' 'don't know,' or refused to answer—stood in the mid-to-late 20% range. In a Gallup poll announced on the 24th (conducted via telephone interviews from April 21-23), the swing voter ratio was 26%, surpassing the PPP's approval rating (20%). In the same survey, the swing voter ratio consistently maintained its position as the 'second-largest party' after the DP, at 28% (1st week of April) → 25% (2nd week of April) → 26% (3rd week of April) → 26% (4th week of April). ( 27일 한국갤럽 등의 전국 단위 여론조사 결과를 보면 ‘지지 정당 없음’ 또는 ‘모름’이라고 답하거나 응답을 거절한 무당층 비율은 20% 중후반대로 나타난다. 갤럽이 지난 24일 발표한 여론조사 결과(4월21~23일, 전화면접조사)를 보면, 무당층 비율은 26%로 국민의힘 지지율(20%)을 웃돌았다. 같은 조사에서 무당층 비율은 28%(4월 1주차)→25%(4월 2주차)→26%(4월 3주차)→26%(4월 4주차)로 민주당에 이은 ‘2당 지위’를 꾸준히 유지했다.)

The proportion of swing voters in these local elections is relatively high compared to the 2022 local elections. In a Gallup Korea poll from the 4th week of April 2022, the swing voter ratio was 17%, 9 percentage points lower than the current figure. This is interpreted as conservative-leaning voters, disappointed by the December 3 insurrection incident and the 'Yoon Again' controversy, abandoning their support for the PPP, thereby increasing the pool of unaffiliated voters. This mirrors the situation during the 2018 local elections, which took place at the start of the Moon Jae-in administration following the impeachment of former President Park Geun-hye, when the swing voter ratio exceeded 20%. ( 이번 지방선거 무당층 비율은 2022년 지방선거 때와 견줘 높은 편이다. 한국갤럽의 2022년 4월 4주차 여론조사 결과 무당층 비율은 17%로 지금보다 9%포인트가 낮았다. 12·3 내란 사태와 ‘윤 어게인’ 논란에 실망한 보수 성향 유권자들이 국민의힘 지지를 접으면서 무당층 비율이 높아진 것으로 풀이된다. 박근혜 전 대통령 탄핵 뒤 출범한 문재인 정부 초기인 2018년 지방선거 당시, 무당층 비율이 20%를 넘겼던 상황과 궤를 같이하는 것이다.)

Regions where the proportion of swing voters exceeds the national average are currently considered key battlegrounds. According to the National Indicator Survey (NBS) released on the 23rd by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research (conducted via telephone interviews from April 20-22), the swing voter ratios in Daegu/North Gyeongsang Province (35%) and Busan/Ulsan/South Gyeongsang Province (35%) surpassed the national average (29%). These are areas where the PPP has historically been strong, but they have emerged as major battlegrounds in this election due to competitive DP candidates. The non-response ratio in Seoul, where a close race between the ruling and opposition parties is anticipated, was also 33%. Notably, the swing voter ratio among those aged 18-29 (50%), typically considered to have stronger opposition party leanings, was significantly higher than those in their 30s (38%), 40s (23%), 50s (20%), 60s (20%), and 70s or older (26%) (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (무당층 비율이 전국 평균치보다 높은 지역들은 현재 격전지로 꼽힌다. 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 지난 23일 공개한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과(4월20~22일·전화면접조사) 대구·경북(35%)과 부산·울산·경남(35%)의 무당층 비율은 전국 평균(29%)을 웃돌았다. 국민의힘의 강세 지역이면서 동시에 민주당 후보들의 선전으로 이번 지방선거 최대 격전지로 떠오른 곳들이다. 여야 접전이 예고된 서울의 무응답층 비율도 33%였다. 야당 지지 성향이 강한 것으로 평가되는 18~29살(50%)의 무당층 비율이 30대(38%), 40대(23%), 50대(20%), 60대(20%), 70대 이상(26%)에 견줘 크게 높은 것도 눈에 띈다(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조).)

Opinions are divided on how the high proportion of swing voters will impact the election dynamics. While swing voters are generally perceived to have lower voter turnout, the possibility that conservative-leaning unaffiliated voters might coalesce at the end of the campaign cannot be ruled out. Regarding this, Kim Chun-seok, head of the survey division at Hankook Research, stated, "Under the current circumstances, there may be more swing voters leaning toward the PPP side, but some may not vote at all, and it won't necessarily shift entirely in one direction." Conversely, Yoon Tae-gon, head of the political analysis office at The More, said, "Unaffiliated voters who previously supported the PPP are highly likely to return to the party. The key will be whether the PPP provides them with a reason to come back, or whether the DP gives them an excuse to return." ( 높은 무당층 비율이 선거 판세에 어떤 영향을 미칠지는 전망이 엇갈린다. 통상 무당층은 투표 참여율이 낮다고 인식되지만, 보수 성향 무당층 유권자들이 선거 막판에 결집할 가능성도 배제할 수 없는 탓이다. 이에 대해 김춘석 한국리서치 여론조사부문장은 “지금 상황상 국민의힘 쪽 무당층이 더 많을 수는 있는데 투표를 안 할 사람도 있고, 한쪽으로만 쏠리지는 않을 것”이라고 말했다. 반면 윤태곤 더모아 정치분석실장은 “국민의힘을 지지했다가 철회한 무당층은 국민의힘으로 다시 돌아갈 가능성이 높다”며 “앞으로 국민의힘이 그들에게 (돌아올) 명분을 주느냐, 혹은 민주당이 (돌아갈) 핑계를 주느냐가 중요할 것”이라고 말했다.)

The DP is also closely monitoring the swing voter ratio in battlegrounds, remaining on high alert. Particularly in the Yeongnam region, where the outcome may be determined by a slim margin of votes, the party plans to target the sentiments of swing voters hesitant to support the DP based on 'candidate character.' An official from candidate Kim Kyoung-soo's camp for South Gyeongsang Province governor stated, "We will emphasize the need for a leader who can revive the economy, rather than framing it as a progressive-conservative dichotomy." An official from candidate Kim Boo-kyum's camp for Daegu mayor said, "Our life-or-death task is to persuade those who say, 'I can't stand the sight of the PPP and won't vote,' to give us another look. It's also necessary not to offend their feelings. We are proceeding with constant caution and vigilance, as if walking on thin ice." ( 민주당도 격전지 무당층 비율을 주시하며 바짝 긴장하는 모습이다. 특히 작은 표차로 당락이 결정될 것으로 보이는 영남권에선 ‘인물론’으로 민주당 지지를 주저하는 무당층의 표심을 공략할 계획이다. 김경수 경남지사 후보 캠프 관계자는 “진보-보수의 구도보다는 경제를 살릴 지도자란 점을 어필할 것”이라고 말했다. 김부겸 대구시장 후보 캠프 관계자는 “‘국민의힘은 꼴 보기 싫어, 투표 안 할란다’는 분들에게 한번 더 봐달라고 말해야 하는 게 절체절명의 숙제”라며 “이분들의 마음에 거슬리지 않는 것도 필요하다. 항상 신중, 조심, 살얼음판을 걷는 느낌으로 임하고 있다”고 했다.)

PPP candidates for metropolitan mayoral positions plan to target swing voters by distancing themselves from the party and running policy-focused campaigns. An official from candidate Oh Se-hoon's camp for Seoul mayor stated, "We believe citizens are more interested in issues related to quality of life than political ideology. Rather than artificially improving relations with the central party, we will emphasize the candidate's policies and capabilities." An official from candidate Choo Kyung-ho's camp for Daegu mayor also said, "Many people couldn't make a choice because they 'can't stand the sight' of the party constantly fighting. We aim to show the competent image that conservatism once symbolized." ( 국민의힘 광역단체장 후보들은 당과 거리를 두며 정책 중심 캠페인을 펼쳐 무당층을 공략한다는 방침이다. 오세훈 서울시장 후보 캠프 관계자는 “시민들은 정치적 이념보다도 삶의 질과 관련된 부분에 관심이 많을 거라고 믿는다”며 “인위적으로 중앙당과 관계를 개선하는 것보다는 후보자의 정책과 능력을 강조할 것”이라고 말했다. 추경호 대구시장 후보 캠프 관계자도 “당에서 맨날 싸우는 모습을 보여서 ‘꼴 보기 싫다’며 선택을 못 했던 분들이 많다”며 “보수를 상징하던 유능한 모습을 보이려 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "On Workers' Memorial Day, I'll Take Full Responsibility So We Can Move Beyond Mourning to Recovery" (이 대통령 “산재노동자의 날, 애도 넘어 회복 말할 수 있게 끝까지 책임”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 28th, "On Workers' Memorial Day for Industrial Accident Victims, I deeply mourn all the workers who did not return from their workplaces." (이재명 대통령이 28일 “산업재해노동자의 날을 맞아 일터에서 돌아오지 못한 모든 노동자들을 마음 깊이 추모한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee wrote on X (formerly Twitter) on the same day, "I will fulfill my responsibility to the end so that Workers' Memorial Day for Industrial Accident Victims can become a day not just of mourning and remembrance, but also a day to pledge safety and talk about recovery." (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “산업재해노동자의 날이 애도와 추모를 넘어 안전을 다짐하고 회복을 이야기하는 날로 자리잡을 수 있도록 끝까지 책임을 다하겠다”고 썼다.)

Furthermore, President Lee emphasized that eradicating industrial accidents is a major national agenda for the people's sovereign government. President Lee stated, "'Sustainable growth based on safety' is also an unshakable core principle of state affairs. With multifaceted government efforts and cooperation between labor and management, changes are being detected on the ground, including a 17.5% reduction in industrial accident fatalities in the first quarter of this year compared to the previous year. However, faced with the weight of precious lives we failed to protect and the heart-wrenching cries of those who lost family and neighbors, we still have a long way to go." (그러면서 이 대통령은 산재 근절이 국민 주권 정부의 주요 국정과제라고 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “‘안전에 기반한 지속 가능한 성장’ 역시 결코 흔들릴 수 없는 국정의 핵심 원칙”이라며 “정부 차원의 다각적인 노력과 노사의 협력이 더해져 올해 1분기 산재 사망자가 전년 대비 17.5% 감소하는 등 현장에서 변화가 감지되고 있다. 그러나 지켜내지 못한 고귀한 생명의 무게, 가족과 이웃을 떠나보낸 애끓는 절규 앞에서 우리는 아직 갈 길이 멀다”고 했다.)

President Lee continued, "I will mobilize every possible means to ensure that the foundation of life no longer becomes a site of death." He added, "I will thoroughly overhaul laws and systems to prevent the recurrence of 'familiar tragedies where only the people change' due to neglected risks and small gaps. If necessary, I will establish new standards and systems." (이 대통령은 이어 “더는 삶의 터전이 죽음의 현장이 되지 않도록 가능한 모든 수단을 동원하겠다”며 “방치된 위험과 작은 빈틈으로 인해 ‘사람만 뒤바뀐 익숙한 비극’이 반복되지 않도록 법과 제도를 빈틈없이 정비하겠다. 필요하다면 새로운 기준과 제도도 마련하겠다”고 말했다.)

President Lee also said, "Before the stigma of being ranked first in the OECD for industrial accident fatality rates, the achievement of being the world's 10th-largest economy can never be a source of pride," and added, "Growth achieved in safe workplaces is truly sustainable growth that guarantees the happiness of the people." (이 대통령은 또 “‘산재 사망률 경제협력개발기구(OECD) 1위’의 오명 앞에서 세계 10위 경제 대국이라는 성취는 결코 자랑스러울 수 없다”며 “안전한 일터에서 이뤄낸 성장이야말로 국민 행복을 담보하는 지속 가능한 성장”이라고 덧붙였다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jin-sook says "I will not refuse if the party wants me to run" in response to running in a difficult metropolitan area (이진숙, 수도권 험지 출마에 “당이 원하면 마다하지 않겠다”)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook, former chairperson of the Korea Communications Commission, who gave up running for mayor of Daegu in the June 3 local elections, said on the 27th regarding the by-elections for National Assembly seats, "If there is something I can do, I will not refuse even a difficult district." This appears to signal her possible candidacy in the metropolitan area. (6·3 지방선거 대구시장 출마를 포기한 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장이 27일 국회의원 재보선과 관련해 “할 수 있는 일이 있다면 험지도 마다하지 않겠다”고 말했다. 수도권 출마 가능성을 내비친 것으로 보인다.)

Appearing on SBS's 'Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show' that day, when asked, "If the party asks you to fight in a difficult district in the metropolitan area, like Hanam or other places, would you accept?", the former chairperson replied, "To stop the reckless expansion of the Democratic Party regime, I will not refuse any role. I will do everything I can." (이 전 위원장은 이날 에스비에스(SBS) ‘김태현의 정치쇼’에 출연해 “당이 수도권 험지, 하남이라든가 여러 군데가 있는데 나와서 싸워 달라고 하면 응하겠느냐”는 질문에 “무도한 민주당 정권의 확장을 막기 위해 어떤 역할도 마다하지 않겠다. 제가 할 수 있는 일은 다 하겠다”고 답했다.)

Previously, the day before the results of the People Power Party's Daegu mayoral primary were announced, on the 25th, the former chairperson held a press conference in Daegu and announced her decision not to run. When asked, "Did you meet with party leader Jang Dong-hyuk in Seoul on the 23rd before the press conference?" she responded, "Yes. Chairman Jang requested that I join forces to fight against the Democratic Party regime by entering the National Assembly." Regarding the possibility of Rep. Choo Kyung-ho, who was selected as the Daegu mayoral candidate, running in the Daegu Dalseong by-election, she said, "It is not appropriate to respond when Rep. Choo has not even resigned." (앞서, 이 전 위원장은 국민의힘 대구시장 경선 결과 발표 하루 전인 지난 25일 대구에서 기자회견을 열어 불출마 뜻을 밝혔다. 그는 “기자회견에 앞서 23일 장동혁 대표와 서울에서 만났느냐”고 묻자 “맞다. 장 대표가 국회에 들어와서 민주당 정권과 싸우는 데 힘을 합쳐달라는 취지의 요청을 했다”고 말했다. 그는 대구시장 후보로 뽑힌 추경호 의원의 대구 달성 보궐선거 출마 가능성에 대해 “추 의원이 사퇴도 하지 않은 시점에서 답하는 것은 적절치 않다”고 했다.)

The former chairperson stated, "Responsibility for excluding me from the nomination (cutoff) lies not only with Nomination Committee Chairman Lee Jung-hyun but also with party leadership, including Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk, who failed to prevent it," while adding, "With less than 40 days until the election, if the party leader steps down, it will cause great chaos. To properly conduct the election, we must unite as one." (이 전 위원장은 “저를 공천배제(컷오프)한 것은 “이정현 공관위원장 뿐 아니라 그를 막지 못한 장동혁 대표 등 당 지도부에게도 공동책임이 있다”면서도 “선거가 40일도 남지 않은 상황에서 당대표가 물러나면 큰 혼란이 생긴다. 선거를 제대로 치르려면 단일대오로 똘똘 뭉쳐야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Senior North Korean Nuclear Envoy: “North Korea’s Nuclear Program, the Most Urgent Challenge to the Non-Proliferation Regime” (북핵수석대표 “북핵, 비확산 체제에 가장 시급한 도전”)
item.description:
Jung Yeon-du, the Director General for Diplomatic Strategy and Intelligence at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and senior envoy on North Korean nuclear diplomacy, attended the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) meeting, reaffirming the government’s goal of “complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula” and emphasizing the urgency of resolving the North Korean nuclear issue. (북핵 외교 수석대표인 정연두 외교부 외교전략정보본부장이 핵확산금지조약(NPT) 회의에 참석해 정부의 ‘한반도의 완전한 비핵화’ 목표를 재확인하고 북핵 문제 해결의 시급성을 강조했다.)

In a keynote speech at the 11th NPT Review Conference held in New York, USA, on the 27th (local time), Director Jung stated, “North Korea is the only case that has benefited from the NPT regime, declared its withdrawal, and openly continued to develop nuclear weapons,” calling it “the most urgent challenge to the non-proliferation regime.” (정 본부장은 27일(현지시간) 미국 뉴욕에서 열린 제11차 NPT 평가회의 기조연설을 통해 “북한은 NPT 체제의 혜택을 누리다가 탈퇴를 선언하고 공개적으로 핵무기 개발을 지속하는 유일한 사례”라며 “비확산 체제에 대한 가장 시급한 도전”이라고 했다.)

Emphasizing that the North Korean nuclear issue is a critical matter directly linked to the integrity of the NPT, Director Jung declared that the Korean government, “while consistently maintaining the goal of complete denuclearization and lasting peace on the Korean Peninsula, will implement a step-by-step denuclearization plan of halt-reduction-dismantlement through dialogue and cooperation.” He also urged North Korea to respond to these efforts and return to and comply with its international obligations under the NPT and UN Security Council resolutions. (정 본부장은 북핵 문제가 NPT의 완결성과 직결되는 중요한 현안이라고 강조하면서, 우리 정부는 “한반도의 완전한 비핵화와 항구적 평화 구축 목표를 일관되게 견지하는 가운데, 대화와 협력을 통해 중단-축소-폐기의 단계적 비핵화 방안을 이행해 나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다. 또한 북한이 이러한 우리의 노력에 호응하고, NPT 및 유엔 안보리 결의 등 국제사회의 의무에 복귀하고 이를 준수할 것을 촉구했다.)

Director Jung stressed that the NPT is closely tied to the peace, stability, and prosperity of the Korean Peninsula, while also emphasizing South Korea’s firm commitment to non-proliferation. (정 본부장은 NPT는 한반도의 평화, 안정, 번영과 긴밀히 연관되어 있다면서 우리의 확고한 비확산 의지도 강조했다.)

Director Jung urged the member states to return to the spirit of the treaty’s original conclusion and reaffirm their commitment to strengthening the three pillars of the NPT regime—disarmament, non-proliferation, and peaceful use—calling on “nuclear-weapon states to engage in dialogue aimed at enhancing transparency and building mutual trust.” (정 본부장은 당사국들이 조약 체결 당시의 정신으로 돌아가 NPT 체제의 3대 축인 군축, 비확산, 평화적 이용 강화 의지를 재확인해야 한다면서 “핵보유국들이 투명성 제고와 상호 신뢰 구축을 위한 대화에 나설 것”을 촉구했다.)

With the Iran nuclear issue emerging as an international concern amid the U.S.-Israel-Iran war, this conference is proceeding under a situation where the risk of the NPT regime becoming “hollowed out” is greater than ever. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁으로 이란 핵 문제가 국제적인 관심사로 떠오른 가운데 열린 이번 회의는 어느 때보다도 NPT 체제의 ‘공동화 위기’가 커진 상황에서 진행되고 있다.)

The NPT, which entered into force in 1970 and was joined by South Korea in 1975, obligates the five nuclear-weapon states (the United States, Russia, the United Kingdom, France, and China) to engage in nuclear disarmament negotiations, prohibits other nations from developing or possessing nuclear weapons, while guaranteeing their right to peaceful nuclear energy use. (1970년 발효되고, 1975년 한국도 가입한 NPT는 5개 핵무기 보유국(미국, 러시아, 영국, 프랑스, 중국)에는 핵군축 협상을 의무화하고, 나머지 나라들엔 핵무기 개발과 보유를 금지하되 평화적 핵 이용 권리는 보장했다.)

However, the New Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty (New START), a nuclear disarmament pact between the United States and Russia, expired in February, and nuclear-weapon states are strengthening their nuclear arsenals. Meanwhile, Iran, which had not developed nuclear weapons, came under attack from the nuclear-weapon state the United States and Israel. (하지만 지난 2월 미국과 러시아 간 핵 군축 조약인 ‘신전략 무기 감축 협정’(New START)가 종료됐고 핵보유국들은 핵전력 증강에 나서고 있다. 반면 핵무기를 만들지 않은 상태였던 이란은 핵보유국 미국과 이스라엘의 공격을 받았다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Swiftly Prepare Measures and Solutions to Strengthen Substantial Protection of Teachers' Authority" (이 대통령 “실질적 교권 보호 강화 방안·해법 조속히 마련하라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 28th ordered, "The government must swiftly prepare measures and solutions to strengthen substantial protection of teachers' authority." (이재명 대통령이 28일 “정부는 실질적 교권 보호 강화를 위한 방안과 해법을 조속히 마련하라”고 지시했다.)

President Lee stated during a cabinet meeting held at the Blue House on the same day, "Recently, incidents infringing on teachers' human rights and educational activities have occurred. The normalization of public education begins with ensuring teachers' human rights and authority. We must create an environment that reduces administrative tasks outside of teaching." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “최근 교사의 인권과 교육활동을 침해하는 사건이 발생하고 있다”며 “공교육 정상화는 교사의 인권과 권위 보장에서 출발한다. 수업 외 행정을 줄이는 환경을 조성해야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee also commented on the tendency of schools to avoid external activities such as field trips and excursions. He said, "I hear that these days, they rarely go on field trips or excursions. But aren't those also part of the curriculum? There are things to learn through group activities, but this trend exists due to concerns about the risk of safety accidents or being held responsible for management." (이 대통령은 학교에서 수학여행, 소풍 등 대외활동을 꺼리는 분위기에 대해서도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “요즘은 수학여행, 소풍도 잘 안 간다고 하더라. 그런데 그것도 수업의 일부 아니냐”라며 “단체활동을 통해 배우는 것도 있는데, 안전사고 위험이나 관리 책임이 부과되지 않을까 하는 걱정 때문에 이런 경향이 있다”고 말했다.)

Continuing, President Lee added, "When I was in school, I didn't only have good memories, but the elementary school field trip to Gyeongju remains a lifelong memory, and I learned a lot from it. If there are problems with group class activities, we can improve them; if there are safety issues, we can assign safety personnel or hire additional staff. Aren't we depriving students of good opportunities by trying to avoid responsibility?" (이어 이 대통령은 “저도 학교 다닐 때 좋은 추억만 있었던 건 아니지만, 초등학교 때 경주 수학여행은 평생의 기억으로 남았고 배운 것도 많다”며 “단체 수업활동에 문제가 있으면 개선하고, 안전에 문제가 있으면 안전요원을 두거나 인력을 추가로 채용하면 되지 않느냐. 책임을 피하려다 학생들에게 좋은 기회를 빼앗는 것 아니냐”고 덧붙였다.)

Seo Young-ji, reporter yj@hani.co.kr Ko Kyung-joo, reporter goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Urges Creation of Productive Public Service Jobs (이 대통령 “생산적인 공공서비스 일자리 발굴해 달라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung instructed on the 28th, "Each ministry should identify productive public service jobs." (이재명 대통령이 28일 “각 부처에서 생산적인 공공서비스 일자리를 발굴해달라”고 지시했다.)

During a cabinet meeting chaired at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, "In an era of job scarcity, while South Korea remains a subject of debate, the quality of jobs in the public service sector is poor and the quantity is insufficient. I'm not asking for the hiring of tens of thousands of people, but if such jobs exist, please conduct a thorough investigation at the level of each ministry's bureaus and divisions and look into it." President Lee directed Prime Minister Kim Min-seok to oversee these matters. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “일자리가 부족한 시대에, 대한민국은 논쟁의 대상이긴 하지만 공공서비스 영역의 일자리의 질도 별로고 양도 많지 않다”며 “수천, 수만명을 고용하라는 게 아니라 있으면 하되, 각 부처 실국 단위로 엄밀히 조사해서 챙겨봐 달라”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 김민석 국무총리가 주관해 해당 사항을 챙기라고 지시했다.)

President Lee said, "The National Tax Service's delinquent tax collection unit is a prime example. Over 100 trillion won is owed in back taxes, isn't it? Even collecting just 10% would yield 10 trillion won, and hiring 10,000 additional people to collect more would still be profitable." He added, "There are likely many such types of public service jobs. Focus on identifying productive public service jobs and report back to me later." (이 대통령은 “국세청 체납관리단이 대표적인데 (체납액이) 100조 이상이 밀려 있다는 거 아니냐. 10%만 (걷어도) 10조원이고, 이걸 추가로 걷는데 1만명을 써도 남는 것”이라고 말했다. 이어 “이런 유형의 공공 서비스 일자리가 많이 있을 수 있다”며 “생산적인 공공 서비스 일자리 발굴에 주력해 나중에 보고해 달라”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Cho Gap-je: "Ha Jung-woo's Timing for Candidacy Too Late…Outmaneuvered by Han Dong-hoon" (조갑제 “하정우 출마 타이밍 늦어…한동훈에 기선제압 당해”)
item.description:
Regarding Ha Jung-woo, the Presidential Secretary for AI Future Planning, who expressed his intention to resign and prepare to run in a by-election, Cho Gap-je, CEO of Cho Gap-je Dotcom, assessed that his "timing is too late." Cho, who has made favorable remarks toward former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon, stated that if Secretary Ha runs in Busan's Buk-gu and Gangseo-gu, it would be a "clash between organization and momentum." (하정우 청와대 인공지능(AI)미래기획수석이 청와대에 사의를 표명하며 보궐선거 출마 준비에 나선 것을 두고 조갑제 조갑제닷컴 대표가 “타이밍이 늦었다”고 평가했다. 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표에게 우호적인 발언을 해온 조 대표는 하 수석이 부산 북갑에 출마할 경우 “조직 대 바람의 대결”이 될 것이라고 말했다.)

On the 27th, Cho appeared on CBS Radio's "Park Jae-hong's One-Round Match" and commented, "I think the timing for (Secretary Ha's candidacy) is late," adding, "It should have been a surprise announcement and handled that way, but he was outmaneuvered by former leader Han Dong-hoon." He continued, "So far, there are no concrete achievements in AI. Since there's nothing substantial to boast about—like, for example, if he had done something comparable to candidate Lee Myung-bak's Cheonggyecheon restoration, then maybe—but there are no results." (조 대표는 27일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판승부’에 나와 “(하 수석 출마) 타이밍이 늦었다고 본다”며 “아주 전격적으로 (출마) 발표를 하고 이렇게 돼야 하는데 한동훈 전 대표에게 기선을 제압당한 것”고 평가했다. 이어 “지금까지 에이아이로 이룬 구체적인 성과가 없다. ‘내가 이걸 했다’고 내세울 만한 게 없으니까 예컨대, 이명박 후보처럼 청계천을 했다든지, 이 정도 들고 나온다면 몰라도 (성과가) 없다”고도 했다.)

When the host asked, "There is a counterargument that if he starts campaigning alongside (Democratic Party Busan mayoral candidate) Jeon Jae-soo, there might be some expectations from Busan citizens," Cho replied, "In the (Buk-gu, Gangseo-gu) region, candidate Jeon Jae-soo has personally built up a considerable number of organizational votes. So that's no easy opponent," adding, "(This by-election will be) a battle between organization and momentum." (진행자가 ‘전재수 (더불어민주당 부산시장) 후보랑 함께 유세를 시작한다거나 하면 부산 시민으로서도 기대할만한 부분이 있지 않겠냐는 반론도 있다’고 묻자 조 대표는 “(부산 북갑) 지역이 전재수 후보가 개인적으로 뛰어가지고 만들어 놓은 조직표가 꽤 있을 것 아닌가. 그러니까 그게 절대 만만치 않다”며 “(이번 보궐선거는) 조직이냐, 바람이냐의 대결”이라고 했다.)

Cho argued, "(Regarding the People Power Party fielding a candidate in Buk-gu,) an assassin nomination would require both killing Han Dong-hoon and self-destructing, which would ultimately favor Ha Jung-woo," and "Based on past precedents, the purpose of the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership is to undermine Han Dong-hoon, so they seem likely to field a candidate. But even if they do, considering local public opinion and the national political landscape, a comeback victory for Han Dong-hoon is possible." Within the People Power Party, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik has expressed his intention to run. (조 대표는 “(국민의힘이 북갑 후보를 내는) 자객 공천은 한동훈도 죽이고 본인도 죽어야 그게 자객 공천인데 그러면 결국 하정우씨가 유리한 국면”이라며 “지금까지 관례로만 보면 장동혁 체제의 존재 목적이 한동훈 꺾기니까 (후보를) 낼 것 같기는 하다. 근데 낸다고 하더라도 지역구 여론이라든지 전국의 판세 이런 게 더해지면 한동훈의 역전승이 가능해진다”고 주장했다. 국민의힘에선 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관 등이 출마 의사를 밝힌 상태다.)

Secretary Ha expressed his resignation to the presidential office on this day. Ha, who previously served as the head of the AI Innovation Center at Naver Cloud, worked as an AI expert before entering the political arena. (하 수석은 이날 청와대에 사의를 표명했다. 네이버클라우드 에이아이 혁신센터장 출신인 하 수석은 정치권 입문 전 인공지능 전문가로 활동해왔다.)

Busan's Buk-gu and Gangseo-gu is currently the constituency of Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo. If Jeon, who was ultimately selected as the Democratic Party's Busan mayoral candidate, resigns on the 29th, a by-election for the National Assembly seat will be held. (부산 북갑은 현재 전재수 민주당 의원의 지역구다. 민주당 부산시장 후보로 최종 선출된 전 의원이 29일 사퇴하면 국회의원 보궐선거가 열릴 예정이다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Why the Anxiety That Defense Is Difficult Without Foreign Troops… Our Military Strength Ranks 5th" (이 대통령 “외국군 없으면 방위 어렵단 불안 왜 갖나…군사력 5위”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 28th, "Our defense industry exports have surged to 4th place in the world, so why do we feel anxious that it would be difficult to defend ourselves without foreign troops?" (이재명 대통령이 28일 “방위산업 수출이 세계 4위로 뛰어올랐는데, 왜 우리가 외국 군대가 없으면 자체 방위가 어려울 듯한 불안감을 갖느냐”고 말했다.)

At a Cabinet meeting presided over at the Presidential Office, President Lee stated, "Recently, it seems some people are feeling anxious about military and security issues for various reasons. But what's clear is that the Republic of Korea, even excluding the U.S. Forces Korea, ranks 5th in the world in terms of its own military strength, doesn't it? Isn't that from a private U.S. analysis organization?" (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “최근 이런저런 이유로 군사·안보 분야의 불안감을 가진 분들이 좀 있는 것 같다”며 “그런데 분명한 건 대한민국은 전세계에서 주한미군을 빼고도 자체 군사력 수준이 세계 5위 아니냐. 미국의 민간 분석기구 발표 아니냐”고 말했다.)

President Lee then added, "Our annual defense spending is 1.4 times higher than North Korea's annual GDP," and urged Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek, "Please inform the public of these objective facts." South Korea's defense budget for this year amounts to 66 trillion won. (이 대통령은 이어 “연간 국방비 지출 금액도 북한의 연간 국내총생산(GDP)보다 1.4배 높다”며 “이런 객관적 상황을 국민에게 알려달라”고 안규백 국방부 장관에게 당부했다. 한국의 올해 국방비는 66조원 규모다.)

In response, Minister Ahn said, "There is a tendency for some forces to stoke anxiety, but most citizens are not like that." (그러자 안 장관은 “일부 세력이 불안을 부추기는 경향이 있으나 대부분 국민은 그렇지 않다”고 말했다.)

President Lee said, "A nation must defend itself—why depend on others? We are fully capable. We must ensure that some people don't feel even a hint of anxiety. We need to increase defense spending and make sure everyone fully understands there's no need to worry." (이 대통령은 “국가는 스스로 지켜야지, 왜 의존하느냐. 충분히 할 수 있다”며 “일각에서 불안을 조금이라도 갖지 않게 해야 한다. 국방지출도 늘리고, 걱정 안 해도 된다는 걸 충분히 인식되도록 해야 한다”고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr and Ko Kyung-ju, Reporter goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)
